Plugin.Name: NBD Export
Plugin.Overview: Export a disk or partition as a Network Block Device and image remote nbd:// targets to qcow2 or raw. Settings → Network Services → NBD (next to NFS and SMB). Needs qemu-nbd and qemu-img (usually with Unraid VMs). Read-only by default; Destructive mode off; no bind-all unless enabled. Prefer private or Thunderbolt binds. Thunderbolt Net optional for underlay. Security notes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ibigsnet/NBDExport/main/SECURITY.md
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: NBD NBDExport qemu-nbd qemu-img block export imaging NbdExport nbdexport
